_meta.description: Typed SkillCard index for aigent-OS skill router. Skills are data, not hardcoded triggers.

cards.name: agent-fitness
cards.description: Track and surface sub-agent dispatch calibration ratios. Extract from JSONL transcript or read existing ledger. Per-agent clean/blocked/errored/partial trends.
intent_patterns: user wants to know which sub-agents are performing well
user wants dispatch calibration data

cards.name: body-check
cards.description: Compose the AIgent's body state — reads HEAT_INDEX, usage_log, DECISION_LOG, ACTIVE_PRIORITIES, DELEGATION_TRACKER, MEMORY_CANDIDATES. The 'how am I doing?' read.
intent_patterns: user wants a aigent-OS health/state readout
user asks about context or memory pressure

cards.name: brief
cards.description: Generate a structured delegation brief for any task — scope, context, deliverable, and acceptance criteria a sub-agent can act on without follow-up.
intent_patterns: user wants to delegate work to a sub-agent
user needs a structured handoff document

cards.name: caddy-audit
cards.description: Walk the skill index against the SKILL.md files on disk and report drift — cards for skills that no longer exist, skills on disk that were never enrolled, and descriptions that have changed since enrollment.
intent_patterns: user suspects the skill index is out of sync with disk
user wants an enrollment drift report

cards.name: caddy-enroll
cards.description: Enroll a skill into the router index so it can be surfaced when the right prompt arrives. Use when a new skill is created, copied in, or when a skill needs updated triggers.
intent_patterns: user created or copied in a new skill and wants it routable
user wants to fix a skill's triggers

cards.name: caddy-explain
cards.description: Walk the router's scoring transparently when a hint fires and the reason is unclear — which trigger matched, what it scored, what the threshold was, and which skills were close runners-up.
intent_patterns: user is confused why a router hint appeared
user wants routing decisions made inspectable

cards.name: caddy-mute
cards.description: Suppress Caddy hints for a bounded duration — auto-restores, respects flow
intent_patterns: user wants Caddy hints suppressed temporarily
user is in deep focus mode

cards.name: capsule-compact
cards.description: Compact a long capsule chain. Walks parent_capsule_id backward from a head capsule; if the chain reaches five or more, summarizes the oldest three into a chain-summary capsule.
intent_patterns: capsule chain has grown long enough to need summarizing
user wants to compact capsule history

cards.name: close
cards.description: DEPRECATED by the two-verb lifecycle — /context-capsule now absorbs close (there is no separate close ceremony; the capsule verb reconciles, writes, and stops). Kept for manual invocation during the transition.
intent_patterns: user wants to end the session
user is wrapping up

cards.name: codex-adapter
cards.description: Route one bounded, mechanical task to the Codex CLI as a non-Claude executor, under the same review-before-merge gate as any other agent-produced diff.
intent_patterns: user explicitly wants a mechanical change handed to a non-Claude executor
user names Codex for a scripted edit

cards.name: comms-summarize
cards.description: Read an inbox, channel, or message thread and return a structured unread summary — sender, topic, action required, and urgency. Read-only.
intent_patterns: user wants a digest of unread messages
user wants to triage an inbox without reading it all

cards.name: compact-note
cards.description: Distill a high-churn, bloated note into a standing-rule summary plus a truncated log. Preserves signal, removes noise, and explains every preservation decision.
intent_patterns: a vault note has grown too long to be useful
user wants a note distilled without losing standing rules

cards.name: context-capsule
cards.description: The capsule verb — reconcile from the live memory, write a resume-ready capsule, stop. Absorbs /close: there is no separate close ceremony. Threshold-triggered refreshes run the same contract automatically.
intent_patterns: context window is getting full
user wants to save progress for resume
user wants to end the session
a task or thread just shipped

cards.name: critique-plan
cards.description: Take a strategic plan, architectural decision, or proposal and return adversarial pre-commitment review — strongest counterargument first, hidden assumptions surfaced, alternatives named.
intent_patterns: user is about to commit to a plan and wants it challenged
user wants adversarial review before a decision

cards.name: decide
cards.description: Run a decision through the twelve-lens decision framework and return a reasoned recommendation rather than an option survey.
intent_patterns: user faces a decision between concrete options
user wants a structured decision framework applied

cards.name: deep-recon
cards.description: Extended multi-agent research sessions — brainstorm, explore, structured output
intent_patterns: user wants thorough research on a topic
user wants multi-angle exploration

cards.name: diagnose
cards.description: Walk the seven-layer stack (kernel, skills, hooks, daemons, vault, doctrine, operator config) and report which layer is most likely responsible for a symptom.
intent_patterns: something is misbehaving and the responsible layer is unknown
user describes a symptom rather than a cause

cards.name: digest
cards.description: Background curation — reviews MEMORY_CANDIDATES.md and surfaces promote/skip/supersede choices. Never auto-promotes.
intent_patterns: user wants to process staged memory candidates
user wants to review memory backlog

cards.name: dream
cards.description: Offline consolidation — scan recent daily notes for patterns, extract durable improvement candidates, and surface them for review. Proposes only; never auto-applies.
intent_patterns: user wants recent experience scanned for durable improvements
user is running a consolidation or reflection pass

cards.name: envelope
cards.description: Classify an incoming directive as Ship, Ask one focused question, or Propose first — forcing a sharp decision instead of a multi-option survey.
triggers: how should I handle this request
do I need to ask first
intent_patterns: user is unsure whether work should ship directly or be proposed
agent is about to over-survey or under-ask

cards.name: find-weakness
cards.description: Given a specific claim, architecture, or decision, find the single strongest objection and the hidden assumption most likely to be wrong. Sharper and faster than a full plan critique.
intent_patterns: user wants the single sharpest objection to a claim
user wants a fast stress test rather than a full review

cards.name: first-10-moves
cards.description: The operational recon sequence for an unfamiliar codebase or area. Replaces asking for clarification with reading the code first.
triggers: where do I start in this code
intent_patterns: user or agent is dropped into unfamiliar code
user is about to ask a question the code already answers

cards.name: first-win
cards.description: The day-one first-win menu — three simple, high-value tasks that each put a real, usable artifact in the operator's hands in minutes, with no connector or OAuth required.
intent_patterns: a new operator wants a real result on day one
user wants a low-friction starting task

cards.name: frontend-slides
cards.description: Animation-rich HTML presentations — anti-AI-slop slide design
intent_patterns: user wants to create a presentation
user wants to convert PPT to web

cards.name: honesty-check
cards.description: Run the volunteering ledger before declaring work done — what changed and didn't, what was noticed but not fixed, what was guessed, and what tradeoffs were made on the operator's behalf.
intent_patterns: work is about to be declared finished
user wants the unstated caveats surfaced before sign-off

cards.name: humanize-docs
cards.description: Transform AI-generated documentation into human-readable prose — aggressive deformalization of checklist spam, symmetric structures, and template dumps into flowing, colleague-authored writing.
intent_patterns: a document reads as machine-generated and needs rewriting
user wants docs to sound colleague-authored

cards.name: impeccable
cards.description: Frontend interface design, critique, polish — anti-AI-slop aesthetics
intent_patterns: user wants to build or improve a UI
user wants design feedback
user wants a landing page

cards.name: learn
cards.description: Take a brief learning input (a repo, a talk, a new tool) and produce a structured note with category, stack location, relevance verdict, and reconsideration triggers.
intent_patterns: user is processing new material and wants it captured
user wants a relevance verdict on something they just learned

cards.name: learn-from-failure
cards.description: Convert failures into reusable artifacts — classify failure mode, check for recurrence, write durable prevention rule
intent_patterns: a failure occurred and needs to be logged as a durable lesson
user wants to prevent a recurring mistake

cards.name: meta-improve
cards.description: Constrained self-modification — implement approved DREAM_LOG candidates, branch + test + surface for the operator's approval only
intent_patterns: user wants to implement a banked system improvement
user wants to action a DREAM_LOG candidate

cards.name: nightly
cards.description: Evidence-gated pass sequencing /dream, /reconcile, /sweep-now, and /digest into one named nightly routine over your own vault, plus a /system-check gate -- human-gated legs stay human-gated, the routine's own writes are limited to its evidence log
intent_patterns: user wants a scheduled or on-demand maintenance pass over their vault
user asks about nightly self-maintenance or a dream/reconcile/sweep/digest routine

cards.name: open
cards.description: DEPRECATED by the two-verb lifecycle — /resume now absorbs open (the post-clear boot runs it automatically; the router should route open-shaped intent to resume). Kept for manual invocation during the transition.
intent_patterns: user starts a new session
user wants to pick up where we left off

cards.name: operator-setup
cards.description: The first-run operator-business interview — learn the operator's business in three plain questions, write the first memory, and play back a personal briefing.
intent_patterns: a new operator is running first-time setup
user wants the system to learn their business context

cards.name: orient
cards.description: Load the canonical map when it is unclear where something lives, who owns what, what the rules are, or what to do next.
intent_patterns: user is confused about geography, ownership, or standing rules
user needs the map before guessing

cards.name: pause
cards.description: Pause current work with resumable state — captures objective, files touched, last verified state, and blockers into a paused capsule.
intent_patterns: user needs to stop mid-task and resume later
work is blocked pending an external answer

cards.name: port-spec
cards.description: Take a complete written specification and port it into working code or a durable artifact. Confirms scope, reads the target, builds, and returns an honesty ledger.
intent_patterns: a finished spec needs to become working code
user hands over a brief ready for implementation

cards.name: promote
cards.description: Take a slice of the current conversation and promote it to a durable artifact — concept note, project update, person profile, or doctrine entry.
intent_patterns: something worth keeping surfaced in conversation
user wants an insight elevated to permanent content

cards.name: reconcile
cards.description: Cross-system consistency check — find where the vault, projects, and trackers disagree, and propose resolutions. Proposes only; never auto-fixes.
intent_patterns: different records of the same fact disagree
user suspects state has drifted between systems

cards.name: research-deep
cards.description: Multi-source deep research — pulls prior art, web sources, and code, then synthesizes a citation-dense briefing with hypothesis, evidence, and recommendation.
intent_patterns: user wants a thorough, cited briefing on a topic
user needs evidence gathered from several sources

cards.name: resume
cards.description: The resume verb — load the newest valid capsule by created_at, re-ground against live memory, then ACT on waiting_on. Absorbs /open: there is no separate open ceremony. The post-clear boot runs the same contract automatically via daemons/resume-verb.mjs.
triggers: pick up where we left off
intent_patterns: user starts a new session
user wants to pick up where we left off
a session just cleared and needs to re-ground

cards.name: sandbox-routing
cards.description: Self-correct tool choice before flooding context — route long file reads and large command output through a sandbox that returns only the summary.
intent_patterns: agent is about to read a large file for one fact
a command will produce output too large for context

cards.name: scout-vault
cards.description: Read-only graph walk — find all notes related to a topic, trace wikilink chains, inventory a directory, or spelunk a codebase for definitions and call chains.
intent_patterns: user wants to know what already exists on a topic
user needs a read-only survey before building

cards.name: self-review
cards.description: Spawn a reviewer with four to six specific verification questions before declaring non-trivial code work done. Forces structured questions, not a vague quality check.
triggers: did I miss anything in this change
intent_patterns: a non-trivial code change is about to be called finished
user wants structured verification rather than a vague check

cards.name: semantic-search
cards.description: Search notes by meaning using local embeddings rather than exact keywords.
intent_patterns: user wants meaning-based rather than keyword search
exact-match search returned nothing useful

cards.name: setup
cards.description: Configure or reconfigure identity, priorities, authority, projects, people, and decision logic.
intent_patterns: user wants to change core configuration
user is reconfiguring after a change in circumstances

cards.name: ship-adapter
cards.description: Port a schema, interface, or API contract from one shape to another — database adapters, API client wrappers, data transformers. Bounded scope, honesty ledger on delivery.
intent_patterns: a contract needs translating between two shapes
user wants a bounded adapter written

cards.name: skill-audit
cards.description: List every installed skill, when it was last invoked, how often, and whether its description still matches real usage. Flags dead skills for retirement and missing capabilities for creation.
intent_patterns: user wants to know which skills are earning their place
user suspects skills have gone stale

cards.name: skill-hunt
cards.description: Search GitHub and skill marketplaces for missing capabilities — quarantine install, safety scan, test, promote
intent_patterns: user wants to find and install a new skill
user has a capability gap

cards.name: skill-recall
cards.description: Match current task to installed skills via SKILL_LEDGER taxonomy — prefix matching, chain recall, gap detection
triggers: do we have a skill for
intent_patterns: user wants to find the right skill for a task
user asks if a skill exists

cards.name: solution-hunt
cards.description: Creative workaround engine — search local memory, skills, GitHub, docs for alternate routes when blocked
intent_patterns: user is blocked and needs an alternate approach
user wants creative workarounds

cards.name: sprite-spec
cards.description: Produce a complete pixel-art sprite specification — palette, proportions, silhouette, accessories, animation states, frame counts, and image-generation prompts.
intent_patterns: user needs a sprite specified before it is drawn
user wants image-generation prompts for a character

cards.name: start
cards.description: The day-one first-run flow and the everyday home screen. On first launch, greet, run setup, then carry the operator into a real first win. On return, give a short briefing and action menu.
intent_patterns: operator is launching for the first time
operator wants the everyday home screen

cards.name: status
cards.description: aigent-OS operational status — quick health check
intent_patterns: user wants a quick operational status

cards.name: stuck
cards.description: Walk the six-rung escalation ladder before declaring stuck. Most stuck is untried next approach; stopping is the last resort, not the first response.
intent_patterns: user or agent is about to declare inability
the next approach has not actually been tried

cards.name: supersede
cards.description: Apply supersede semantics to a note — strike outdated entries, add new ones with dates, preserve history, and flag what was kept and why.
intent_patterns: a recorded fact is no longer true
user wants history preserved while updating a record

cards.name: sweep-heat
cards.description: Read the heat index, find the coldest notes, and set them dormant in their frontmatter. Edit-only; returns counts.
intent_patterns: user wants cold notes marked dormant
routine vault heat maintenance

cards.name: sweep-links
cards.description: Scan notes for wikilinks that point to non-existent files and report each broken link with source file and line. Reports only; does not fix.
intent_patterns: user suspects broken links in the vault
routine link-integrity check

cards.name: sweep-now
cards.description: Run all vault sweeps in one pass — stale tracker items, dormant heat flips, and broken wikilinks — and append the result to the sweep log.
intent_patterns: user wants every routine vault sweep run at once
scheduled vault maintenance

cards.name: sweep-tracker
cards.description: Read the delegation tracker, close finished items, archive stale items beyond threshold, and flag orphans. Edit-only on status fields; returns counts.
intent_patterns: the delegation tracker has accumulated finished or stale rows
user wants tracker hygiene run

cards.name: system-check
cards.description: Audit aigent-OS install — verifies kernel, skills, hooks, daemons, vault, semantic search. Reports green/yellow/red.
intent_patterns: user wants to verify aigent-OS is fully operational
user suspects a broken installation

cards.name: taste-skill
cards.description: Opinionated design judgment — distills taste-driven decisions into concrete recommendations
intent_patterns: user wants opinionated design guidance
user wants to elevate design quality

cards.name: timeline-calibration
cards.description: Self-correct timeline estimates. Before quoting hours, days, or weeks of work, re-anchor on tool calls and session cycles rather than human-developer hours.
intent_patterns: an estimate is about to be quoted in human-developer time
user asks how long work will take

cards.name: tool-evaluation
cards.description: Assess a tool, library, or framework against specific needs — alternatives comparison, adoption risks, fit score, and a recommendation.
intent_patterns: user is choosing between tools or libraries
user wants adoption risk assessed before committing

cards.name: trust-decay
cards.description: Capture a confident claim or resolve one as right or wrong, building the longitudinal record of calibration over time.
intent_patterns: a confident claim was just made and should be logged
an earlier claim turned out right or wrong

cards.name: ui-architecture
cards.description: Take a brief for a new screen, component, or design system and produce a complete visual architecture spec — component tree, layout grid, interaction states, breakpoints, tokens. No code.
intent_patterns: a new UI surface needs specifying before it is built
user wants structure and tokens rather than code

cards.name: visual-polish
cards.description: Audit an existing UI surface against palette, proportion, hierarchy, and motion, and return specific, actionable improvements. Spec output only.
intent_patterns: an existing UI needs a critique pass
user wants concrete visual improvements listed
